title: Boolean encoding of the binary inner product
statement: For each natural number $n$, the Boolean function on sign vectors of length $2n$ converts each sign vector to its corresponding binary vector, computes the inner product modulo two, and encodes the result as a sign.
caveat: The definitions of the bit inner product, sign-to-bit conversion, and sign encoding are not included, so their precise conventions cannot be stated.
